snippet.title: LONG GONE [ gamescom 2025 Wishlist Trailer ] PC
snippet.description:
WISHLIST here 👉🏼 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1977610/Long_Gone/

Gamescom Wishlist Trailer for Long Gone, a 3D pixel art narrative adventure game coming to PC on Steam.

Website & Press kit: https://www.LongGoneGame.com
Follow development on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/hillfortgames 
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/MJw3n2tHjt

Decades have passed, play as a survivor stranded in an old suburban neighborhood. Explore the secret lives of people Long Gone through their forgotten belongings and platform through overgrown streets in this 3D pixel narrative adventure inspired by games of old. Oh, and watch out for the zombies.

Project funded by Outersloth by @Innersloth 
#indiegame #Trailer #gamescom 

-------------------------------------------
Music by: Studio Chimp
